RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of unlawful bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate discrimination. Modern public broadcasters heavily prioritize digital transformation; the successful candidate’s "strong experience of digital media" likely aligned with key strategic goals, which often outweighs traditional tenure. 

Additionally, two weeks is a standard administrative turnaround time for written feedback in public organizations. Raising allegations based solely on panel demographics without concrete evidence of irregular scoring will severely harm your professional standing and burn bridges. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on how your digital competencies were scored compared to the role requirements.
